meta.access_policy: ATTENTION: AGENTS MUST ONLY READ OR OPERATE THIS TEMPLATE THROUGH THE xc-orchestration-author SKILL AND ITS PUBLIC COMMANDS. DO NOT OPEN, SUMMARIZE, EDIT, PATCH, OR REFORMAT THIS FILE DIRECTLY.

node.title: Prepare feature adoption
node.instructions: Read the project bridge, create the run through xc-create-run, determine and validate run.document_language through xc-document from the explicit parameter or initiating user request, identify existing code boundaries, select an explicit feature ID, and create its empty directory through xc-feature.
node.deliverables: An authoritative run directory, explicit code-entry scope, and empty managed feature directory.
node.acceptance: The feature is not already managed, run.document_language is set before any document write, and the adoption scope has enough evidence to begin analysis.

node.title: Approve adopted feature baseline
node.instructions: Present the code-derived baseline, evidence gaps, and any target-versus-current differences. Record approval, required revision, or an explicit unresolved conflict.
node.deliverables: An adoption decision and any required follow-up nodes.
node.acceptance: The feature baseline is approved as current evidence or the workflow is blocked on an explicit product decision.

node.title: Finalize feature adoption
node.instructions: Confirm the adopted feature documents, provenance, artifacts, and unresolved evidence gaps, then close the run.
node.deliverables: A completed, failed, or blocked adoption run with durable result evidence.
node.acceptance: No ordinary run is needed to infer whether the feature was adopted successfully.
